content:
The three arcs between the chosen vertices have positive integer lengths summing to 10. If an arc has length \(g\), its chord length corresponds to \(k=\min(g,10-g)\), where \(k\in\{1,2,3,4,5\}\).

List the unordered partitions of 10 into 3 parts and their side-length types:

\[
\begin{aligned}
(1,1,8)&\to (1,1,2)\\
(1,2,7)&\to (1,2,3)\\
(1,3,6)&\to (1,3,4)\\
(1,4,5)&\to (1,4,5)\\
(2,2,6)&\to (2,2,4)\\
(2,3,5)&\to (2,3,5)\\
(2,4,4)&\to (2,4,4)\\
(3,3,4)&\to (3,3,4)
\end{aligned}
\]

These 8 side-length multisets are all distinct, and each determines a unique congruence class by SSS.

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
